limits: This is a provisional, developing public-source CAST analysis, not a completed or exhaustive investigation. Search completeness and a maximal number of obtainable facts are not claimed.
All16 original question records remain open. The new layer records public evidence and remaining gaps; no external requests were sent and no private operational logs/interviews were obtained.
27 evidence updates include new artifacts/publications, rechecked accounts, methodology, commentary and an unverified assurance lead. They are not27 new independent historical events.
The two METR files contain derived agent summaries and hourly activity aggregates. Their1,206 and1,772 rows are not additions to the832-record inventory and share source lineage with the METR report.
Background density is illustrative. Hidden catalogue numbers identify decorative stars only, without historical event identities, dates or detailed incident records.
198 linked records span70 source episodes. They are not198 independent observations; selected coverage does not imply that unlinked records are irrelevant.
The six reported changes are grouped improvements; the six proposals are analyst recommendations, not historical events, assigned tasks, implemented changes or proven optimal interventions.
192 records are reviewed Context and41 reviewed Unresolved; these retain null scores rather than invented harm levels. Zero is Near-miss.
